# `sysid` register map

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_regmap.py from regmap/sysid.yaml. Do not edit. -->

Bitstream identification. The host API reads this block first and refuses to talk to a bitstream whose MAGIC or ABI version it does not recognise, which turns "the driver silently talks to yesterday's design" into a clear error.

6 registers, 24 bytes.

| Offset | Name | Access | Reset | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ------ | ----- | ----------- |
| `0x00` | `MAGIC` | ro | `0x5A4D4958` | Constant identifying a ZMIX platform bitstream. |
| `0x04` | `ABI_VERSION` | ro | `0x00000000` | Register-map ABI version. Host drivers check MAJOR for compatibility. |
| `0x08` | `GIT_SHA` | ro | `0x00000000` | First 32 bits of the git commit the bitstream was built from. |
| `0x0C` | `BUILD_UTC` | ro | `0x00000000` | Build timestamp as a UNIX epoch second count. |
| `0x10` | `CAPABILITY` | ro | `0x00000000` | Which optional blocks this bitstream actually contains. |
| `0x14` | `SCRATCH` | rw | `0x00000000` | Read/write scratch word. The host self-test uses it to prove the bus works end to end. |

## `ABI_VERSION` (`0x04`, ro)

Register-map ABI version. Host drivers check MAJOR for compatibility.

| Bits | Field | Description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| `23:16` | `MAJOR` | Breaking register-map changes. |
| `15:8` | `MINOR` | Additive |
| `7:0` | `PATCH` | Patch level. |

## `CAPABILITY` (`0x10`, ro)

Which optional blocks this bitstream actually contains.

| Bits | Field | Description |
| ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| `11:8` | `VARIANT` | Build variant: 0=A ps-linux, 1=B baremetal, 2=C pl-only, 3=D rest. |
| `3` | `HAS_PL_UDP` | PL-side UDP control plane present (variant C). |
| `2` | `HAS_OLED` | oled_ctrl present. |
| `1` | `HAS_DAC` | dac_spi present. |
| `0` | `HAS_ADC` | adc_ad7476 present. |
